description:
T1	Poplar (Populus spp)	Fell to ground level and remove all arisings. Tree is leaning heavily over neighbours property. Adjacent Poplar tree has already had a large branch failure. To be done using MEWP.  Reason for fell tree is too big and leaning heavily.

T4	London plane (Platanus × hispanica)	30% Crown Reduction - Reducing the height and spread of the tree by approximately 2-3m to tidy and contain. Final heights 17m and final spreads 12m.
 
T5	London plane (Platanus × hispanica)	30% Crown Reduction - Reducing the height and spread of the tree by approximately 2-3m to tidy and contain. Final heights 12m and final spreads 8m.
